Run every channel for one unit and write chimera + chimera_windows

Source: R/chimera.R
chimera_unit.Rd

Run every channel for one unit and write chimera + chimera_windows

Usage

chimera_unit(
  con,
  id,
  path = 1L,
  scaffold = 1L,
  dbarg = NULL,
  taxdump_dir = NULL,
  label_db = NULL,
  threads = 1L,
  workdir = tempfile("chimera_"),
  review = FALSE
)

Arguments

con

Open DBI connection.

id

Sample ID.

path, scaffold

Assembly unit within the sample.

dbarg

blastn -db argument for the windowed local BLAST channel, or NULL/"" to fall back to label_db in identity-only mode.

taxdump_dir

Local NCBI taxdump directory (or NULL for the bundled one).

label_db

Path to a labels FASTA/BLAST db used when dbarg is absent.

threads

blastn thread count.

workdir

Scratch directory for intermediate files.

review

TRUE checks the contig's review copy: its sequence, features, hits, and ITSx chimera flag come from the review tables, coverage is cut to the copy's window, and the result goes to review_chimera and review_chimera_windows.

Value

(invisibly) the written chimera row, as a list.
